response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT mj.major_id, mj.department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member me JOIN major mj ON me.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.major_id, mj.department), s AS (SELECT major_id, department, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM m), d AS (SELECT major_id, department, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS dept_avg FROM s) SELECT major_id, department, cnt AS member_count, share, share - dept_avg AS diff_from_dept_avg FROM d WHERE share > dept_avg ORDER BY (share - dept_avg) IS NULL, (share - dept_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
